name: CNN/DailyMail
description: CNN/DailyMail is a dataset for reading comprehension and abstractive summarization. Originally used with fill-in-the-blank reading comprehension (anonymized entity cloze), it was repurposed as a summarization benchmark. Each example consists of a CNN or Daily Mail news article with human-written highlights (bullet-point summaries).
reputation: One of the most widely used summarization benchmarks; standard evaluation for seq2seq models and LLMs; used in hundreds of NLP papers
notes: Originally introduced at NeurIPS 2015 as a reading comprehension dataset using anonymized cloze tests. Repurposed for abstractive summarization by See et al. (ACL 2017). Contains 287K training, 13K validation, 11K test examples. The news highlights often mix extractive and abstractive content. Standard benchmark alongside XSum for summarization research.
